WITH r AS (
  SELECT fs.*, s.store_id, p.sku
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
    AND cp.category='Paint & Decorating'
)
SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) rows_n, count(distinct (store_id, sku)) distinct_store_sku, count(distinct (store_key, product_key)) distinct_keys,
  count(distinct etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), count(distinct store_id) stores, min(store_id), max(store_id), sum(closing_value) val
FROM r GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH r AS (
  SELECT fs.week_ending_date, s.store_id, p.sku, fs.closing_units, fs.closing_value, fs.receipts_units, fs.adjustment_units, p.standard_unit_cost, p.product_name
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
    AND cp.category='Paint & Decorating'
),
a AS (SELECT * FROM r WHERE week_ending_date=DATE '2026-07-05'),
b AS (SELECT * FROM r WHERE week_ending_date=DATE '2026-07-12')
SELECT a.store_id, a.sku, a.product_name, a.closing_units, a.closing_value, a.standard_unit_cost, a.receipts_units, a.adjustment_units
FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.store_id=b.store_id AND a.sku=b.sku WHERE b.sku IS NULL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT fs.week_ending_date,
  count(*) n,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(fs.closing_value - fs.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) value_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_units,
  sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_value<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_value,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.valid_from > fs.week_ending_date OR p.valid_to < fs.week_ending_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) version_out_of_range,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.category<>'Paint & Decorating' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) aswas_other_cat,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonphysical,
  max(fs.closing_value) maxv, max(fs.closing_units) maxu,
  sum(fs.closing_value) val, sum(fs.closing_units) units
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND cp.category='Paint & Decorating'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH params AS (
    SELECT period_start_date AS start_date, period_end_date AS end_date
    FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 3
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT fs.week_ending_date, SUM(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category,
       ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_weekly_closing_stock_value_at_cost_eur, COUNT(*) AS weeks_averaged
FROM weekly
